data_manifest.notes: All valid and invalid positions preserved. Source contains detection/ellipse/pixel/XYZ/joint/timestamp evidence, not raw images. No left-arm calibration performed in this data synchronization.

selection_criterion: Minimum pooled blocked-CV RMS; parameter count breaks exact ties.
validation: 5 outer trajectory blocks in valid-waypoint order, purge 2 adjacent valid positions; 4 inner blocks for model selection; 50 frames never split.

diagnostics.note: Correlations are descriptive, confounded by trajectory; they do not identify causal error sources.

sensitivity.note: Sensitivity probes, not new calibration targets, ground truth or causal attribution.

warnings: No images: intrinsics were not recalibrated.
